name: desktop-jarvis
description: DesktopJarvis — a voice assistant for your Mac that speaks in your cloned voice

scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:native && npm run build:icon
scripts.dev: npm run build:ts && npm run build:native && npm run build:icon && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.app: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-builder --mac dir
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p renderer/tsconfig.json

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: DesktopJarvis listens when you hold the talk button so it can hear your request.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: DesktopJarvis controls apps such as Word, Mail and your browser to carry out what you ask.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: DesktopJarvis reads and adds calendar events when you ask about your schedule.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: DesktopJarvis reads and adds calendar events when you ask about your schedule.
extendInfo.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: DesktopJarvis creates and reads reminders when you ask it to remind you of things.
